subject: Access evidence request: SSO/SCIM tenant proof handoff
messages:
From: Jamie Cole <jamie.cole@evergreensys.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Access evidence request: SAML/SCIM samples for SOC 2 review

Hi Sean / Redwood team,

As part of Evergreen Systems' annual SOC 2 walkthrough we need a short package that demonstrates how Redwood handles identity & access artifacts for our tenant. In scope items we need by EOD Friday (11/12):
- One redacted SAML assertion sample (IdP->SP) showing attributes you surface (NameID/audience/eduPersonPrincipalName or email, group claims, session index).
- A SCIM export (CSV or JSON) with a representative slice of users + group membership and role mapping (ok to redact emails).
- A short RBAC / role-owner mapping (who owns which role) and evidence of least-privilege defaults for new users.

Could you confirm: 1) what artifacts you can deliver by 11/12, 2) whether we should expect full raw assertions or redacted copies, and 3) if you need a secure upload link or prefer Drive.

Thanks — appreciate the fast turn here.

Jamie Cole
Sr. InfoSec Engineer, Evergreen Systems
security@evergreensys.com

Attachment: scope-checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Cole <jamie.cole@evergreensys.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Access evidence request: SAML/SCIM samples for SOC 2 review

Hi Jamie — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely get a compact package together by 11/12. Quick confirmations and owners below: 

- SAML assertion sample (redacted): Laura will provide a redacted assertion showing the standard attributes and audience fields. We will strip any PII and use placeholder emails.
- SCIM export sample: Vanessa will deliver a CSV slice (20 users) with groups and role mapping. Emails will be hashed but role names preserved.
- Role-owner matrix: I will attach an owner spreadsheet and include a short note about least-privilege defaults for new users.

Question: do you need logs (SAML authn events / SCIM change history) or is the artifact bundle + owner matrix sufficient for this pass?

If you prefer, we can upload to your portal link; otherwise we'll place artifacts on a restricted Drive folder and send a link plus an HMAC token for access.

I'll mark internal action items and follow up with the Drive link when content is staged.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com

Attachment: n/a

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Cole <jamie.cole@evergreensys.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Access evidence request: SAML/SCIM samples for SOC 2 review

Jamie — looping in what I'll deliver and timeline.

Deliverables I own:
- scim-export-sample.csv (20 users, group membership column, role_id mapping). All PII redacted; emails replaced with user001@redacted.local, etc.
- access-owners-mapping.xlsx (role -> owner -> last reviewed).
- short readme.txt describing how SCIM delta syncs are recorded in our audit log.

Laura will produce the SAML assertion sample and a short note about the NameID format and attribute mapping.

Wanted to call out two items for your intake: 
1) SCIM export includes service accounts; do you want those excluded? We can either include a single masked service account line or exclude them entirely.
2) For role-owner matrix, we can include internal team emails (Redwood) and your Redwood contact mapping; is linking to your internal approvers helpful?

I'll stage the CSV + owner sheet to a restricted Drive folder and share the link once Laura's SAML file is ready so you have everything in one place.

Attachment: workback-plan.xlsx (internal planning stub)

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Compliance Program Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Cole <jamie.cole@evergreensys.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Nov 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Access evidence request: SAML/SCIM samples for SOC 2 review

Jamie / team — attaching the SAML assertion sample and the RBAC mapping export. Per Sean's note, I've redacted all PII and replaced real emails with placeholders. The assertion below is provided as an example (redacted values).

--- begin saml-assertion-sample.xml ---
<samlp:Response IssueInstant="2027-11-11T23:20:00Z" Destination="https://app.evergreensys.com/sso/acs" ID="id-abc123" Version="2.0">
  <Issuer>https://idp.redwood.com</Issuer>
  <saml:Assertion ID="assert-xyz789" IssueInstant="2027-11-11T23:20:00Z">
    <saml:Subject>
      <saml:NameID Format="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress">user001@redacted.local</saml:NameID>
      <saml:SubjectConfirmation Method="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:cm:bearer">
        <saml:SubjectConfirmationData NotOnOrAfter="2027-11-11T23:25:00Z" Recipient="https://app.evergreensys.com/sso/acs"/>
      </saml:SubjectConfirmation>
    </saml:Subject>
    <saml:Conditions NotBefore="2027-11-11T23:20:00Z" NotOnOrAfter="2027-11-11T23:25:00Z">
      <saml:AudienceRestriction>
        <saml:Audience>https://app.evergreensys.com</saml:Audience>
      </saml:AudienceRestriction>
    </saml:Conditions>
    <saml:AttributeStatement>
      <saml:Attribute Name="email">
        <saml:AttributeValue>user001@redacted.local</saml:AttributeValue>
      </saml:Attribute>
      <saml:Attribute Name="groups">
        <saml:AttributeValue>eng-readonly</saml:AttributeValue>
        <saml:AttributeValue>project-alpha</saml:AttributeValue>
      </saml:Attribute>
      <saml:Attribute Name="role">
        <saml:AttributeValue>viewer</saml:AttributeValue>
      </saml:Attribute>
    </saml:AttributeStatement>
  </saml:Assertion>
</samlp:Response>
--- end saml-assertion-sample.xml ---

Notes:
- Audience and Recipient values are preserved to show ACS binding.
- We included a groups attribute to show group-to-role mapping at the SP.
- We can provide a signed assertion sample if you need to validate certificate fingerprints — let me know.

Attachments included in Drive: saml-assertion-sample.xml, scim-export-sample.csv, access-owners-mapping.xlsx

Drive link (restricted): https://drive.re/redwood/evergreen/saml-sample (HMAC token included in the e-mail sent separately)

Let me know if you need the SCIM audit delta (change history) — that can be exported but will need additional redaction.

— Laura Bennett
Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Jamie Cole <jamie.cole@evergreensys.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Nov 2027 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Access evidence request: SAML/SCIM samples for SOC 2 review

Laura / Vanessa / Sean — thank you, this is exactly what we needed for the SOC 2 prep. I verified the Drive bundle and the attachments look correct. Two quick asks before we close the ticket: 

1) Can you swap the group name "project-alpha" to a generic name (project-x) in both the SAML sample and SCIM CSV? Our internal policy asks for generic test group names.
2) Please add a one-line statement in the owner matrix confirming the date of last role review for each owner (YYYY-MM-DD).

If you prefer, you can upload the revised files to our secure intake: https://securityportal.evergreensys.com/submission/REQ-2291 (token: will be sent separately).

If you can do those two small edits by EOD today I can mark this request as satisfied for our auditor. Really appreciate the fast turnaround.

—Jamie
Jamie Cole
Sr. InfoSec Engineer, Evergreen Systems
security@evergreensys.com
